title: MAP3K3 regulates NF-kappaB activation in endothelial cells
abstract: We show that MAP3K3 (MEKK3) is required for NF-kappaB signalling. Knockdown of MAP3K3 reduced p65 nuclear translocation by 61%.

title: MAP3K7 (TAK1) in innate immunity
abstract: MAP3K7, also known as TAK1, mediates TLR signalling. This study does not examine MAP3K3.

title: Trifluridine/tipiracil versus fluoropyrimidines in colorectal cancer
abstract: Trifluridine/tipiracil (TAS-102) retained activity in 5-FU refractory tumours because trifluridine is incorporated into DNA rather than inhibiting thymidylate synthase.

title: N6-methyladenosine (m6A) controls mRNA stability
abstract: m6A marks on mRNA alter stability, splicing and translation efficiency.
